title: OLL Parity
scramble: 3r2 B2 U2 3l U2 3r' U2 3r U2 F2 3r F2 3l' B2 3r2
notes: Single flipped edge pair on top layer - occurs in 50% of 6×6 solves during OLL stage
story: Like 4×4, the 6×6 experiences OLL parity due to its even layer count. The algorithm is similar but uses 3-layer wide moves.
description: OLL parity on 6×6. Two edge pieces appear flipped when you reach OLL. Uses 3-layer wide moves (3r, 3l) instead of 2-layer.
